name: Vercel AI Gateway
role: Managed model fallback for private concept planning when the dedicated Pi Agent endpoint is not configured or unavailable.
boundary: Model output must validate against the studio brief schema. Supplier prices, permit status, engineering claims, and completed-project claims may not be invented. Prefer Pi Agent when its authenticated service endpoint is available.

name: Blender
role: Owned scene, parametric concept geometry, editable source, still renders, GLB export, and walkthrough production.
boundary: The studio worker accepts bounded scene specs. Do not expose arbitrary Python execution from the web UI.

name: Microsoft TRELLIS
role: Optional local/open-source generation of decorative or concept-study 3D assets that can be imported into Blender.
boundary: Generated assets are not structural geometry or construction documentation. Verify licenses of included submodules/models before production use.

name: Meshy
role: Optional paid accelerator for AI 3D asset generation and Blender transfer.
boundary: Use for visual assets and ideation, not structural dimensions. Verify current plan, retention, credits, and API model versions before each integration change.
